items.title: Workday shares sink 10% premarket as softer outlook overshadows Q3 beat
items.summary: Investing.com -- Workday reported stronger-than-expected fiscal third-quarter earnings and revenue, but its softer subscription growth and remaining performance obligation (RPO) outlook raised concerns about a slowdown in its core business and the pace of AI monetization.

items.title: Workday (WDAY) Stock Falls 9.7% Premarket Despite Raised Guidance
items.summary: Workday shares fell 9.7% in premarket trading on Wednesday, Nov. 25, as tech stocks sold off on tariff and AI fears, even after the company raised FY27 guidance.
